segments.ja545:1.1: “Ahu rājā videhānaṃ, aṅgati [aṅgāti (sī.) evamuparipi] nāma khattiyo;
segments.ja545:2.1: So ca pannarasiṃ [pannarase (syā. ka.)] rattiṃ, purimayāme anāgate;
segments.ja545:4.3: Cātumāsā komudajja, juṇhaṃ byapahataṃ [byapagataṃ (sī. pī.)] tamaṃ;
segments.ja545:4.5: Kāyajja ratiyā rattiṃ, viharemu imaṃ utuṃ”.
segments.ja545:6.3: Ye te vasaṃ na āyanti, vasaṃ upanayāmase [upaniyyāmase (ka.)];
segments.ja545:6.5: Esā mayhaṃ sakā diṭṭhi, ajitaṃ ojināmase.
segments.ja545:8.3: Uttamo ussavo ajja, na yuddhaṃ mama ruccati.
segments.ja545:11.1: “Na hete dullabhā deva, tava kāmehi modituṃ;
segments.ja545:11.3: Sadāpi kāmā sulabhā, netaṃ cittamataṃ [cittaṃ matī (ka.)] mama.
segments.ja545:12.3: Yo najja vinaye kaṅkhaṃ, atthadhammavidū ise”.
segments.ja545:13.1: Vijayassa vaco sutvā, rājā aṅgati mabravi;
segments.ja545:14.3: Yo najja vinaye kaṅkhaṃ, atthadhammavidū ise.
segments.ja545:15.1: “Sabbeva santā karotha matiṃ, kaṃ upāsemu paṇḍitaṃ;
segments.ja545:15.3: Yo [ko (sī. pī.)] najja vinaye kaṅkhaṃ, atthadhammavidū ise”.
segments.ja545:17.3: Taṃ deva [tadeva (ka.)] payirupāsemu [payirupāsaya (sī. pī.)], so no kaṅkhaṃ vinessati”.
segments.ja545:23.1: So muhuttaṃva yāyitvā, yānā oruyha khattiyo;
segments.ja545:24.1: Yepi tattha tadā āsuṃ, brāhmaṇibbhā samāgatā;
segments.ja545:24.3: Na te apanayī rājā, akataṃ bhūmimāgate.
segments.ja545:27.1: “Kacci akasirā vutti, labhasi [labbhati (sī. pī.)] piṇḍayāpanaṃ [piṇḍiyāpanaṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja545:27.3: Apābādho casi kacci, cakkhuṃ na parihāyati”.
segments.ja545:28.1: Taṃ guṇo paṭisammodi, vedehaṃ vinaye rataṃ;
segments.ja545:29.3: Kacci arogaṃ yoggaṃ te, kacci vahati vāhanaṃ;
segments.ja545:29.5: Kacci te byādhayo natthi, sarīrassupatāpiyā”[sarīrassupatāpikā (sī. pī.), sarīrassupatāpanā (?)].
segments.ja545:31.3: Kathaṃ care ācariye, puttadāre kathaṃ care.
segments.ja545:33.1: “Kathaṃ dhammaṃ caritvāna, maccā gacchanti [pecca gacchati (sī. syā. pī.)] suggatiṃ;
segments.ja545:35.3: Natthi deva paro loko, ko tato hi idhāgato.
segments.ja545:36.1: “‘Natthi deva pitaro vā, kuto mātā kuto pitā;
segments.ja545:36.3: Natthi ācariyo nāma, adantaṃ ko damessati.
segments.ja545:37.3: Natthi balaṃ vīriyaṃ vā, kuto uṭṭhānaporisaṃ;
segments.ja545:37.5: Niyatāni hi bhūtāni, yathā goṭaviso tathā.
segments.ja545:40.3: Tejo pathavī āpo ca, vāyo sukhaṃ dukhañcime;
segments.ja545:40.5: Jīve ca sattime kāyā, yesaṃ chettā na vijjati.
segments.ja545:41.1: “‘Natthi hantā va chettā vā, haññe yevāpi [haññare vāpi (sī. syā. pī.)] koci naṃ;
segments.ja545:42.1: “‘Yo cāpi [yopāyaṃ (sī. pī.), yo cāyaṃ (syā. ka.)] siramādāya, paresaṃ nisitāsinā;
segments.ja545:42.3: Na so chindati te kāye, tattha pāpaphalaṃ kuto.
segments.ja545:43.3: Anāgate tamhi kāle, saññatopi na sujjhati.
segments.ja545:44.3: Pāpañcepi bahuṃ katvā, taṃ khaṇaṃ nātivattare.
segments.ja545:47.3: Piṅgalo nāmahaṃ āsiṃ, luddo goghātako pure.
segments.ja545:48.3: Bahū mayā hatā pāṇā, mahiṃsā sūkarā ajā.
segments.ja545:49.3: Natthi nūna phalaṃ pāpaṃ, yohaṃ [pāpe sohaṃ (sī. pī.)] na nirayaṃ gato.
segments.ja545:50.1: Athettha bījako nāma, dāso āsi paṭaccarī [paḷaccarī (sī. pī.), paṭajjarī (ka.)];
segments.ja545:51.1: Kassapassa vaco sutvā, alātassa ca bhāsitaṃ;
segments.ja545:51.3: Passasanto muhuṃ uṇhaṃ, rudaṃ assūni vattayi.
segments.ja545:52.3: Kiṃ te sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, kiṃ maṃ vedesi vedanaṃ”.
segments.ja545:53.3: “Natthi me vedanā dukkhā, mahārāja suṇohi me.
segments.ja545:54.3: Sāketāhaṃ pure āsiṃ, bhāvaseṭṭhi guṇe rato.
segments.ja545:55.3: Na cāpi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, sarāmi katamattano.
segments.ja545:57.3: Upaḍḍhabhāgaṃ bhattassa, dadāmi yo me icchati.
segments.ja545:58.3: Na cāpi [na ahaṃ (ka.)] bhūte hiṃsāmi, theyyañcāpi vivajjayiṃ.
segments.ja545:59.3: Niratthaṃ maññidaṃ sīlaṃ, alāto bhāsatī yathā.
segments.ja545:62.1: Bījakassa vaco sutvā, rājā aṅgati mabravi;
segments.ja545:63.1: “Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ, niyatiyā kira labbhati;
segments.ja545:67.1: “Candake me vimānasmiṃ, sadā kāme vidhentu me;
segments.ja545:69.3: Na cāpi brāhmaṇibbhesu, atthe kismiñci byāvaṭo.
segments.ja545:70.3: Rājakaññā rucā [rujā (sī. pī.) evamuparipi] nāma, dhātimātaramabravi.
segments.ja545:71.1: ‘Alaṅkarotha maṃ khippaṃ, sakhiyo cālaṅkarontu [ca karontu (sī. pī.)] me;
segments.ja545:71.3: Suve pannaraso dibyo, gacchaṃ issarasantike’[pitussa santike (syā.)].
segments.ja545:73.3: Parikiriya pasobhiṃsu [asobhiṃsu (sī. syā. pī.)], rucaṃ ruciravaṇṇiniṃ.
segments.ja545:77.3: Kacci bahuvidhaṃ khajjaṃ, sadā abhiharanti te.
segments.ja545:78.3: Gharake karotha paccekaṃ, khiḍḍāratiratā muhuṃ [ahu (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja545:79.1: “Kena vā vikalaṃ tuyhaṃ, kiṃ khippaṃ āharantu te;
segments.ja545:79.3: Manokarassu kuḍḍamukhī [kuṭṭamukhī (sī. pī.)], api candasamamhipi”[api candasamampi te (ka.)].
segments.ja545:82.1: Rucāya vacanaṃ sutvā, rājā aṅgati mabravi;
segments.ja545:84.3: Passasanto muhuṃ uṇhaṃ, rudaṃ assūni vattayi.
segments.ja545:85.3: Natthi bhadde paro loko, kiṃ niratthaṃ vihaññasi”.
segments.ja545:90.3: Kīṭova aggiṃ jalitaṃ apāpataṃ, upapajjati mohamūḷho [momuho (sī. pī.)] naggabhāvaṃ.
segments.ja545:91.1: “Saṃsārasuddhīti pure niviṭṭhā, kammaṃ vidūsenti bahū ajānaṃ [bahū pajā (ka.)];
segments.ja545:91.3: Pubbe kalī duggahitovaatthā [attho (ka.), duggahitova’ natthā (?)], dummo ca yā balisā ambujova.
segments.ja545:95.3: Ācināti ca taṃ pāpaṃ, yena gacchati duggatiṃ.
segments.ja545:96.3: Tasseva deva nissando, yañceso labhate sukhaṃ.
segments.ja545:97.1: “Khīyate cassa taṃ puññaṃ, tathā hi aguṇe rato;
segments.ja545:100.3: Pubbevassa [pubbe tassa (sī. pī.)] kataṃ pāpaṃ, tameso paṭisevati.
segments.ja545:101.1: “Khīyate cassa taṃ pāpaṃ, tathā hi vinaye rato;
segments.ja545:102.1: “Yaṃ yañhi rāja bhajati, santaṃ vā yadi vā asaṃ;
segments.ja545:102.3: Sīlavantaṃ visīlaṃ vā, vasaṃ tasseva gacchati.
segments.ja545:103.3: Sopi tādisako hoti, sahavāso hi [sahavāsopi (ka.)] tādiso.
segments.ja545:107.5: Asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatiṃ”.
segments.ja545:108.3: Anāgatāpi satteva, yā gamissaṃ ito cutā.
segments.ja545:109.1: “Yā me sā sattamī jāti, ahu pubbe janādhipa;
segments.ja545:113.3: Paṇḍitaṃ sutasampannaṃ, so maṃ atthe nivesayi.
segments.ja545:114.3: Taṃ kammaṃ nihitaṃ aṭṭhā, nidhīva udakantike.
segments.ja545:115.3: Phalaṃ pariyāga maṃ [pariyāga taṃ (sī.), pariyāgataṃ (syā. pī.)] pacchā, bhutvā duṭṭhavisaṃ yathā.
segments.ja545:116.3: Sakammunā apaccissaṃ, taṃ saraṃ na sukhaṃ labhe.
segments.ja545:117.3: Bhinnāgate [bheṇṇākaṭe (sī. pī.)] ahuṃ rāja, chagalo uddhatapphalo [chakalo uddhitapphalo (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja545:118.1: “Sātaputtā mayā vūḷhā, piṭṭhiyā ca rathena ca;
segments.ja545:120.1: “Tato cutāhaṃ vedeha, dassanesu [dasaṇṇesu (sī. pī.), dasannesu (syā.)] pasū ahuṃ;
segments.ja545:120.3: Niluñcito javo bhadro, yoggaṃ vūḷhaṃ ciraṃ mayā;
segments.ja545:121.3: Nevitthī na pumā āsiṃ, manussatte sudullabhe;
segments.ja545:124.3: Anāgatāpi satteva, yā gamissaṃ ito cutā.
segments.ja545:125.1: “Pariyāgataṃ taṃ kusalaṃ, yaṃ me kosambiyaṃ kataṃ;
segments.ja545:125.3: Deve ceva manusse ca, sandhāvissaṃ ito cutā.
segments.ja545:126.3: Thībhāvāpi na muccissaṃ, chaṭṭhā nigatiyo [chaṭṭhā gatiyo (syā.)] imā.
segments.ja545:128.3: Devaputto javo nāma, yo me mālaṃ paṭicchati.
segments.ja545:129.1: “Muhutto viya so dibyo, idha vassāni soḷasa;
segments.ja545:129.3: Rattindivo ca so dibyo, mānusiṃ saradosataṃ.
segments.ja545:130.3: Kalyāṇaṃ yadi vā pāpaṃ, na hi kammaṃ vinassati [panassati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja545:131.1: “Yo icche puriso hotuṃ, jātiṃ jātiṃ [jātijātiṃ (sī. pī.)] punappunaṃ;
segments.ja545:132.1: “Yā icche puriso hotuṃ, jātiṃ jātiṃ punappunaṃ;
segments.ja545:134.3: Attano hoti atthāya, itthī vā yadi vā pumā.
segments.ja545:135.3: Asaṃsayaṃ tehi pure suciṇṇaṃ, kammassakāse puthu sabbasattā.
segments.ja545:136.1: “Iṅghānucintesi sayampi deva, kutonidānā te imā janinda;
segments.ja545:136.3: Yā te imā accharāsannikāsā, alaṅkatā kañcanajālachannā”.
segments.ja545:137.1: Iccevaṃ pitaraṃ kaññā, rucā tosesi aṅgatiṃ;
segments.ja545:141.1: “Kuto nu āgacchasi devavaṇṇi, obhāsayaṃ sabbadisā [saṃvariṃ (sī. pī.)] candimāva;
segments.ja545:141.3: Akkhāhi me pucchito nāmagottaṃ, kathaṃ taṃ jānanti manussaloke”.
segments.ja545:142.1: “Ahañhi devato idāni emi, obhāsayaṃ sabbadisā [saṃvariṃ (sī. pī.)] candimāva;
segments.ja545:142.3: Akkhāmi te pucchito nāmagottaṃ, jānanti maṃ nārado kassapo ca”.
segments.ja545:143.1: “Accherarūpaṃ tava [vata (sī. pī.)] yādisañca, vehāyasaṃ gacchasi tiṭṭhasī ca;
segments.ja545:143.3: Pucchāmi taṃ nārada etamatthaṃ, atha kena vaṇṇena tavāyamiddhi”.
segments.ja545:144.1: “Saccañca dhammo ca damo ca cāgo, guṇā mamete pakatā purāṇā;
segments.ja545:144.3: Teheva dhammehi susevitehi, manojavo yena kāmaṃ gatosmi”.
segments.ja545:145.1: “Accheramācikkhasi puññasiddhiṃ, sace hi etehi [ete tvaṃ (sī. pī.)] yathā vadesi;
segments.ja545:145.3: Pucchāmi taṃ nārada etamatthaṃ, puṭṭho ca me sādhu viyākarohi”.
segments.ja545:146.1: “Pucchassu maṃ rāja tavesa attho, yaṃ saṃsayaṃ kuruse bhūmipāla;
segments.ja545:146.3: Ahaṃ taṃ nissaṃsayataṃ gamemi, nayehi ñāyehi ca hetubhī ca”.
segments.ja545:147.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ nārada etamatthaṃ, puṭṭho ca me nārada mā musā bhaṇi;
segments.ja545:147.3: Atthi nu devā pitaro nu atthi, loko paro atthi jano yamāhu”.
segments.ja545:148.1: “Attheva devā pitaro ca atthi, loko paro atthi jano yamāhu;
segments.ja545:148.3: Kāmesu giddhā ca narā pamūḷhā, lokaṃ paraṃ na vidū mohayuttā”.
segments.ja545:149.1: “Atthīti ce nārada saddahāsi, nivesanaṃ paraloke matānaṃ;
segments.ja545:149.3: Idheva me pañca satāni dehi, dassāmi te paraloke sahassaṃ”.
segments.ja545:150.1: “Dajjemu kho pañca satāni bhoto, jaññāmu ce sīlavantaṃ vadaññuṃ [vataññuṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja545:150.3: Luddaṃ taṃ bhontaṃ niraye vasantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:151.1: “Idheva yo hoti adhammasīlo [akammasīlo (pī.)], pāpācāro alaso luddakammo;
segments.ja545:151.3: Na paṇḍitā tasmiṃ iṇaṃ dadanti, na hi āgamo hoti tathāvidhamhā.
segments.ja545:152.1: “Dakkhañca posaṃ manujā viditvā, uṭṭhānakaṃ [uṭṭhāhakaṃ (sī.)] sīlavantaṃ vadaññuṃ;
segments.ja545:152.3: Sayameva bhogehi nimantayanti, kammaṃ karitvā puna māharesi”.
segments.ja545:153.1: “Ito cuto [gato (sī. pī.)] dakkhasi tattha rāja, kākolasaṅghehi vikassamānaṃ [kākoḷasaṅghehipi kaḍḍhamānaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja545:153.3: Taṃ khajjamānaṃ niraye vasantaṃ, kākehi gijjhehi ca senakehi [soṇakehi (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja545:153.5: Sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:154.1: “Andhaṃtamaṃ tattha na candasūriyā, nirayo sadā tumulo ghorarūpo;
segments.ja545:154.3: Sā neva rattī na divā paññāyati, tathāvidhe ko vicare dhanatthiko.
segments.ja545:155.1: “Sabalo ca sāmo ca duve suvānā, pavaddhakāyā balino mahantā;
segments.ja545:155.3: Khādanti dantehi ayomayehi, ito paṇunnaṃ paralokapattaṃ [paraloke patantaṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja545:156.1: “Taṃ khajjamānaṃ niraye vasantaṃ, luddehi vāḷehi aghammigehi ca;
segments.ja545:156.3: Sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:157.1: “Usūhi sattīhi ca sunisitāhi, hananti vijjhanti ca paccamittā [pothayanti (ka.)];
segments.ja545:157.3: Kāḷūpakāḷā nirayamhi ghore, pubbe naraṃ dukkaṭakammakāriṃ.
segments.ja545:158.1: “Taṃ haññamānaṃ niraye vajantaṃ, kucchismiṃ passasmiṃ vipphālitūdaraṃ;
segments.ja545:158.3: Sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:159.1: “Sattī usū tomarabhiṇḍivālā, vividhāvudhā vassanti tattha devā;
segments.ja545:160.1: “Uṇho ca vāto nirayamhi dussaho, na tamhi sukhaṃ labbhati [seti (ka.)] ittarampi;
segments.ja545:160.3: Taṃ taṃ vidhāvantamalenamāturaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:161.1: “Sandhāvamānampi [sandhāvamānaṃ taṃ (sī. pī.)] rathesu yuttaṃ, sajotibhūtaṃ pathaviṃ kamantaṃ;
segments.ja545:161.3: Patodalaṭṭhīhi sucodayantaṃ [sucodiyantaṃ (sī. pī.)], ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:162.3: Sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:163.3: Sudaḍḍhagattaṃ kapaṇaṃ rudantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:167.3: Dumagge vitacaṃ gattaṃ [dumaggaviṭapaggataṃ (sī.)], ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanaṃ.
segments.ja545:169.3: Sañchinnagattaṃ ruhiraṃ savantaṃ, ko codaye paraloke sahassaṃ.
segments.ja545:170.1: “Tato nikkhantamattaṃ taṃ, asipattācitā dumā [asipattanirayā dukhā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja545:170.3: Sampatitaṃ vetaraṇiṃ, ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanaṃ.
segments.ja545:171.1: “Kharā kharodakā [khārodikā (sī.), kharodikā (pī.)] tattā, duggā vetaraṇī nadī;
segments.ja545:172.3: Vetaraññe anālambe, ko taṃ yāceyya taṃ dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja545:173.1: “Vedhāmi rukkho viya chijjamāno, disaṃ na jānāmi pamūḷhasañño;
segments.ja545:173.3: Bhayānutappāmi mahā ca me bhayā, sutvāna kathā [gāthā (sī. syā. pī.)] tava bhāsitā ise.
segments.ja545:174.3: Andhakāreva pajjoto, tvaṃ nosi saraṇaṃ ise.
segments.ja545:175.1: “Atthañca dhammaṃ anusāsa maṃ ise, atītamaddhā aparādhitaṃ mayā;
segments.ja545:175.3: Ācikkha me nārada suddhimaggaṃ, yathā ahaṃ no nirayaṃ pateyyaṃ”.
segments.ja545:176.1: “Yathā ahu dhataraṭṭho ()[ettha kiñci ūnaṃ viya dissati], vessāmitto aṭṭhako yāmataggi;
segments.ja545:176.3: Usindaro cāpi sivī ca rājā, paricārakā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
segments.ja545:177.1: “Ete caññe ca rājāno, ye saggavisayaṃ [sakkavisayaṃ (sī. pī.)] gatā;
segments.ja545:178.1: “Annahatthā ca te byamhe, ghosayantu pure tava;
segments.ja545:178.3: Ko chāto ko ca tasito, ko mālaṃ ko vilepanaṃ;
segments.ja545:179.1: “Ko panthe chattamāneti [chatta’ mādeti (sī. syā. pī.)], pādukā ca mudū subhā;
segments.ja545:179.3: Iti sāyañca pāto ca, ghosayantu pure tava.
segments.ja545:180.1: “Jiṇṇaṃ posaṃ gavassañca, māssu yuñja yathā pure;
segments.ja545:187.3: Sati patodo dhīrassa, dhiti yogo ca rasmiyo.
segments.ja545:188.1: “Mano dantaṃ pathaṃ neti [patha’ nveti (sī. pī.)], samadantehi vāhibhi;
segments.ja545:188.3: Icchā lobho ca kummaggo, ujumaggo ca saṃyamo.
segments.ja545:189.3: Paññā ākoṭanī rāja, tattha attāva sārathi.
segments.ja545:190.3: Sabbakāmaduho rāja, na jātu nirayaṃ vaje”.
segments.ja545:192.3: Ānando sā rucā āsi, yā rājānaṃ pasādayi.
